keys.label: START REC
keys.description: OBS: Start Recording. Assign this hotkey manually in OBS. This button does not show recording state.

keys.label: STOP REC
keys.description: OBS: Stop Recording. Assign this hotkey manually in OBS and check the saved recording there.

keys.label: PAUSE
keys.description: OBS: Pause Recording. Assign this hotkey manually in OBS; recording needs a separate recording encoder. No live status is displayed.

keys.label: RESUME
keys.description: OBS: Unpause Recording. Assign this hotkey manually in OBS. Check OBS to confirm recording has resumed.

keys.label: NEXT PAGE
keys.description: Go to the next enabled UlanziDock page.

keys.label: CAMERA
keys.description: OBS: Switch to scene 01 CAMERA. Create the scene and assign this hotkey manually. Keep Studio Mode off.

keys.label: SCREEN
keys.description: OBS: Switch to scene 02 SCREEN. Create the scene and assign this hotkey manually. Keep Studio Mode off.

keys.label: CAM+SCREEN
keys.description: OBS: Switch to scene 03 CAM+SCREEN. Create the scene and assign this hotkey manually. Keep Studio Mode off.

keys.label: BREAK
keys.description: OBS: Switch to scene 04 BREAK. Create the scene and assign this hotkey manually. This does not pause recording or mute audio.

keys.label: MIC ON
keys.description: OBS: Unmute your microphone source. Assign this hotkey manually under that source. This button does not show microphone state.

keys.label: MIC OFF
keys.description: OBS: Mute your microphone source. Assign this hotkey manually under that source. Confirm the mute icon in OBS.

keys.label: DESKTOP ON
keys.description: OBS: Unmute your desktop audio source. Assign this hotkey manually under that source. This does not change Windows master volume.

keys.label: DESKTOP OFF
keys.description: OBS: Mute your desktop audio source. Assign this hotkey manually under that source. This does not change Windows master volume.

keys.label: CLOCK
keys.description: Firmware clock or configured UlanziDock status panel; no physical-press action.
